description: Nembo — Colore: Storm blue & silver texture Collezione: Serēnus Codice: 5980 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Large Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 140 cm × 74.3 cm Toni: Blue NEMBO (Italian for nimbus) was developed from photographs of dramatic cumulonimbus clouds rising over the Giudecca Canal, directly above Fortuny's historic factory. Its pattern explores shadow and light through an interplay of lines of varying densities with a half-drop repeat to expand its organic feel when used in larger scale installations like walls and curtain s . On drapery, the cloud-like movement of the design amplifies the fabric's natural fall. On walls, it creates an immersive atmospheric depth that reads differently with changing light and season. NEMBO is the collection's quietest fabric and its most spatially ambitious. Part of the SEREÑUS collection , Fortuny's last of the first 100 years of production on the Giudecca.
